name: farsiui-calendar
description: Iranian public holidays and observances for Jalali years. Date conversion is not included — consumers use a Jalali library (e.g. @internationalized/date).
source: Official University of Tehran Calendar Center (calendar.ut.ac.ir).
notes: Friday is a weekend day in Iran but is not listed as a holiday item; clients should treat weekends separately.
Schema is designed for FarsiUI calendar UI to import JSON statically or fetch via GitHub Raw.
